notes.title: 1.0.0.6 is released.
notes.content:
1.0.0.6 is released for both the full game and demo.

[b]Improvement[/b]: Modified tutorial sessions to use pictures to explain.

[b]Bug fixed:[/b]
1) When virus is dead or revived, near by processes will update their colors, to reflects door module's range is modified from virus's dead/revive.

2) when gathering from command "go ... and gather and go ...", move virus away using "go" command, will no longer crush the game.

notes.title: The game (1.0.0.5) has been released!
notes.content:
The game (1.0.0.5) has been released. Hope your guys enjoy it.

Please make sure you have played the Demo before you buy, so there is no installation issue and you know if you will like it or not. The Full game is not much different from the Demo: just more content (Act 5) with more challenge enemies.

This game requires Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8 installed. If Steam failed to install it, you can install it manually.

If there is any installation problem or bug, please reply/add-discussion to this Announcement, so I can try to help you out.

Have a great day.  ^_^

Dev.
